from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u061/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-5c9f10f2.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]
    segments = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
            if dr and abs(dr) == abs(dc):
                sr, sc = (1 if dr > 0 else -1), (1 if dc > 0 else -1)
                pts = [(r1 + k * sr, c1 + k * sc) for k in range(abs(dr) + 1)]
                segments.append((sr, sc, pts))
                for r, c in pts:
                    if out[r][c] == grid[r][c] and grid[r][c] == 4:  # background
                        out[r][c] = 1
    for sr, sc, pts in segments:
        for r, c in sixes:
            if (r, c) in pts:
                # Extend the perpendicular diagonal through this 6 to both grid edges.
                dr, dc = sr, -sc
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr - dr < h and 0 <= cc - dc < w:
                    rr, cc = rr - dr, cc - dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                    if out[rr][cc] == 4:
                        out[rr][cc] = 6
                    rr, cc = rr + dr, cc + dc
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path)
